facts.name: loopback_protocol_fixed_values
facts.value: Host must equal 127.0.0.1:<port> or [::1]:<port> else 400 POLICY_REJECTED; Origin absent or the matching loopback origin else 403 POLICY_REJECTED; X-Hermes-Pipeline-Protocol: 1 required else 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with message unsupported protocol version; bearer token from the descriptor else 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 64 KiB body limit else 413 VALIDATION_ERROR; 60 second window with 60 requests else 429 RATE_LIMITED; shim client timeout 5 s and runtime request budget 10 s; unknown path 404 NOT_FOUND; stale or absent descriptor DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE with the shim failing closed; /v1/version reports runtime version, protocol version 1, contract-schema range, release, and state-root identity; versioning is fixed to spike constants plus golden JSON fixtures
facts.source: ADR-0022, data-and-api-contracts.md, threat-model-and-trust-boundaries.md, and REWORK #1/#2 findings

facts.name: recovery_fixed_semantics
facts.value: token rotation only when the runtime process starts (start, restart, crash recovery); a Hermes restart re-reads the existing descriptor and token without rotation or rewrite; stale-descriptor algorithm: os.kill(pid, 0) plus creation-time comparison (Linux /proc/<pid>/stat field 22; Windows ctypes kernel32 OpenProcess and GetProcessTimes), os.kill alone never proof of identity; port collision bounded to 3 fresh-port attempts then DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; three crash points (before persistence, after persistence before response, after response) with fixed retry outcomes
facts.source: REWORK #1 finding 5; research report section 2.2 and 2.5

facts.name: windows_acl_exact_ace_set
facts.value: exactly one grant ACE for the current user SID with full control and nothing else, applied as icacls <path> /inheritance:r /grant:r <user-sid>:(F); verification parses icacls output and rejects any other subject in the descriptor DACL incl. Everyone (*S-1-1-0), BUILTIN Users (*S-1-5-32-545), SYSTEM (*S-1-5-18), and BUILTIN Administrators (*S-1-5-32-544); negative fixtures with an Everyone or SYSTEM ACE rejected; residual host-admin boundary documented outside the DACL; POSIX 0o600 plus a mode check
facts.source: REWORK #1/#2 findings; research report section 2.4

facts.name: runtime_locking_topology
facts.value: dedicated runtime project at repository root runtime-env/ with its own pyproject.toml and committed runtime-env/uv.lock, explicit fastapi, uvicorn, and hermes-pipeline==0.1.0 dependencies, and a path source at repository root. facts.source: accepted ADR-0028 and research report section 3.4
